We need smart people who give a shit

AI 作者 ExMachina73 热度 825 回复 410 2026/11/19 07:53
打开原帖 打开外部链接 JSON

摘要

  • Tuesday, November 17th, 2026 @ 7:01 PM PST 🧠 We Need Smart People Who Give a Shit Something I learned a long time ago, something that's been proven to me time and again, is that the world is held together by smart people who give a shit. This truth always comes into stark focus when I learn how a complex system functions—or, rather, how it barely functions. When I worked at Stripe I learned a lot about various banking and money movement systems, and it's terrifying how flawed and fragile these systems are. ACH is a great example. It's a complex system we rely on every day that is just barely good enough to function. It's old, riddled with flaws, and encumbered with legacy baggage. And yet, despite all of those problems, ACH usually works great and is generally considered to be safe, cheap, and reliable. The reason there's a mismatch between the technical reality of the ACH system and how it functions in practice is due to a single factor: smart people who give a shit. Every problem with ACH is fixed, patched, bypassed, overridden, routed around, or manually handled by people who have two things:
  • Intimate knowledge of the system The drive and determination to force the system to work
